# HeyGetOnMyLevel

> AI-powered reading practice for all ages. Free, private, judgment-free literacy from kindergarten to college (ages 5–85+). Bilingual ESL mode supports Spanish-speaking learners reading English passages.

HeyGetOnMyLevel finds each learner's reading level through a short assessment (vocabulary + read-aloud), then generates passages and comprehension questions tailored to that level. No accounts, no PII — sessions are ephemeral. Built by Time-2-Read; free for personal use, commercial license required for institutions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, problem statement, start reading or take an assessment.
- [Select Level](/select-level): Pick a reading grade (1–13) and a skill focus.
- [Assessment](/assessment): Vocabulary, read-aloud, or combined assessment to find your level.
- [Curriculum](/curriculum): 200-hour curriculum map across 5 grade bands and 20 modules.
- [Install](/install): Add HeyGetOnMyLevel to your phone, tablet, or desktop as a PWA.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Zero-PII commitment, ephemeral sessions, no tracking.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Personal-use license terms and commercial licensing contact.
